info.title: Settings Service
info.description: This API is intended to manage settings in a ZITADEL instance. This project is in beta state. It can AND will continue breaking until the services provide the same functionality as the current login.

delete.description:
Deprecated: please move to the corresponding endpoint under settings service v2. This endpoint will be removed with the next major version of ZITADEL.

Delete the settings specific to an organization.

Required permissions:
  - `iam.policy.delete`

403.description: Returned when the user does not have permission to access the resource.

404.description: Returned when the resource does not exist.

post.description:
Deprecated: please move to the corresponding endpoint under settings service v2. This endpoint will be removed with the next major version of ZITADEL.

Sets the settings specific to an organization.
Organization scopes usernames defines that the usernames have to be unique in the organization scope, can only be changed if the usernames of the users are unique in the scope.

Required permissions:
  - `iam.policy.write`

403.description: Returned when the user does not have permission to access the resource.

404.description: Returned when the resource does not exist.

post.description:
Deprecated: please move to the corresponding endpoint under settings service v2. This endpoint will be removed with the next major version of ZITADEL.

Returns a list of organization settings.

Required permission:
  - `iam.policy.read`
  - `org.policy.read`

docsLink.description: Link to documentation to be shown in the console.

maxPasswordAttempts.description: Maximum password check attempts before the account gets locked. Attempts are reset as soon as the password is entered correctly or the password is reset. If set to 0 the account will never be locked.

resourceOwnerType.description: resource_owner_type returns if the settings is managed on the organization or on the instance
resourceOwnerType.title: resource_owner_type returns if the settings is managed on the organization or on the instance

maxOtpAttempts.description: Maximum failed attempts for a single OTP type (TOTP, SMS, Email) before the account gets locked. Attempts are reset as soon as the OTP is entered correctly. If set to 0 the account will never be locked.

allowUsernamePassword.description: defines if a user is allowed to log in with username and password

allowRegister.description: defines if a person is allowed to register a user on this organization

allowExternalIdp.description: defines if a user is allowed to add a defined identity provider. E.g. Google auth

forceMfa.description: defines if a user MUST use a multi-factor to log in

passkeysType.description: defines if passkeys are allowed for users

hidePasswordReset.description: defines if password reset link should be shown in the login screen

ignoreUnknownUsernames.description: defines if unknown username on login screen directly returns an error or always displays the password screen

defaultRedirectUri.description: defines where the user will be redirected to if the login is started without app context (e.g. from mail)

passwordCheckLifetime.description: Defines after how much time the user has to re-authenticate with the password.

externalLoginCheckLifetime.description: Defines after how much time the user has to re-authenticate with an external provider.

mfaInitSkipLifetime.description: Defines after how much time the mfa prompt will be shown again.

secondFactorCheckLifetime.description: Defines after how long the second factor check is valid.

multiFactorCheckLifetime.description: Defines how long the multi-factor check is valid.

allowDomainDiscovery.description: If set to true, the suffix (@domain.com) of an unknown username input on the login screen will be matched against the org domains and will redirect to the registration of that organization on success.

disableLoginWithEmail.description: defines if the user can additionally (to the login name) be identified by their verified email address

disableLoginWithPhone.description: defines if the user can additionally (to the login name) be identified by their verified phone number

forceMfaLocalOnly.description: if activated, only local authenticated users are forced to use MFA. Authentication through IDPs won't prompt a MFA step in the login.

v2betaOrganizationScopedUsernamesFilter.description: Query for organization settings with specific scopes usernames.

organizationId.description: The unique identifier of the organization the settings belong to.

creationDate.description: The timestamp of the organization settings creation.

changeDate.description: The timestamp of the last change to the organization settings.

organizationScopedUsernames.description: Defines if the usernames have to be unique in the organization context.

offset.description: Starting point for retrieval, in combination of offset used to query a set list of objects.

limit.description:
limit is the maximum amount of objects returned. The default is set to 100
with a maximum of 1000 in the runtime configuration.
If the limit exceeds the maximum configured ZITADEL will throw an error.
If no limit is present the default is taken.

asc.description:
Asc is the sorting order. If true the list is sorted ascending, if false
the list is sorted descending. The default is descending.

totalResult.description: Absolute number of objects matching the query, regardless of applied limit.

appliedLimit.description: Applied limit from query, defines maximum amount of objects per request, to compare if all objects are returned.

minLength.description: Defines the minimum length of a password.

requiresUppercase.description: defines if the password MUST contain an upper case letter

requiresLowercase.description: defines if the password MUST contain a lowercase letter

requiresNumber.description: defines if the password MUST contain a number

requiresSymbol.description: defines if the password MUST contain a symbol. E.g. "$"

maxAgeDays.description: Amount of days after which a password will expire. The user will be forced to change the password on the following authentication.

expireWarnDays.description: Amount of days after which the user should be notified of the upcoming expiry. ZITADEL will not notify the user.
